title: Ask your record
subtitle: Questions are answered by fixed rules from your own record. No AI model sees your data, and nothing you ask is stored.
placeholder: e.g. What is my latest HbA1c?

examples.LAB_TREND: Is my HbA1c trend going up?
examples.CONDITIONS: What conditions am I diagnosed with?
examples.WHAT_CHANGED: What changed in the last 30 days?
examples.WHO_ACCESSED: Who viewed my records this month?

answers.unmatched: I can only answer questions of these kinds:

lab.no_tests: No lab results are on your record yet.
lab.unknown_test: I could not tell which test you meant. Tests on your record: {tests}.

medications.none: No active medications are on your record.

conditions.none: No diagnoses are on your record.

allergies.none: No allergies are set on your emergency card.

changed.none: Nothing was added to your record in the last {days} days.

access.none: Nobody else has viewed your record in the last {days} days.

access.title: {count} views by other people in the last {days} days
access.truncated: Showing the most recent {count}. Open the access log for the full history.

emergency.title: This is what a paramedic scanning your QR would see
emergency.notSetUp: Your emergency card is not set up, so a paramedic would see nothing.

filter.accessible_entries: Your medical entries, through the consent filter

receipt.logged: This question was recorded in your access log as an analytics view. The question text was not kept.
receipt.notLogged: Nothing was read, so nothing was logged.

error: Could not answer that. Try again.
